about: This breakfast is part of the PembrokeKIDS series at Pembroke Gardens, the open-air shopping center along Pines Boulevard, so it works as an easy morning stop for families already in the area.
The same weekend has other Pembroke Pines holiday plans, including the city's SnowFest on December 5, which is a separate event for residents with free tickets.
Because seating is limited to reservations, the listing is clear that walk-ins are not part of the plan, so the phone call to Brimstone is the real first step.
faq: How do I reserve a seat at Brimstone?
Call Brimstone directly. The Shops at Pembroke Gardens says reservations are required.
What do kids do besides see Santa?
They can color, decorate and make their own Christmas ornaments to take home.
The listing does not print a price, so ask Brimstone when you call to reserve.
The listing invites the whole family to the breakfast, with the coloring and ornament making aimed at little ones.
